# vendor/

`xbox-xcloud-player` is cloned and built here by:

```powershell
npm run setup:player
```

Source: https://github.com/unknownskl/xbox-xcloud-player (MIT).

The app loads `xbox-xcloud-player/dist/assets/xCloudPlayer.min.js` as a plain
UMD script and uses `xCloudPlayer.default.Player` + `.ApiClient`.
